verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe agents running on a 'durable background queue' and building 'durable agents' that preserve progress across failures/restarts and handle long-running, asynchronous, human-in-the-loop workflows — direct support for background autonomous automation. However this is a code-first framework primitive requiring the developer to wire up the queue/durability infra themselves, not a turnkey scheduler, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirms real-world autonomous background runs in production. Missing for 10: third-party/hands-on validation of long-running background automations, built-in scheduling/trigger mechanism.
